name: dealerboard
description: A local macOS status board for coding agents.

scripts.check: biome ci . && bun run build && bun test
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build:core
scripts.build:app: bun build app/src/main.ts --outdir app/dist --target browser --minify && cp app/index.html app/styles.css app/dist/
scripts.dev:app: bun run build:app && cd app && bunx tauri dev
scripts.bundle:app: bun run build:app && cd app && bunx tauri build
